t: The stated purpose of the revelation
a: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
p: Mā anzalnā ʿalayka-l-qur'āna li-tashqā, illā tadhkiratan li-man yakhshā.
m: We have not sent down to you the Qur’ān that you be distressed But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allāh] -
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
